facts.fact: The Palace is still the seat of the Sicilian Parliament; institutional or religious events can cause partial/complete closures.
facts.excerpt: the Monumental Complex of the Royal Palace, as the seat of the Sicilian Parliament, and the Palatine Chapel may be subject to full or partial closures or schedule changes without prior notice

facts.fact: Current operator notice describes planned Palatine Chapel restoration and possibly inaccessible areas.
facts.excerpt: due to scheduled restoration works at the Palatine Chapel, opening and closing times will undergo temporary changes.

facts.fact: The operator lists Chapel,Royal Apartments,Royal Gardens as separate areas, with specific access to be checked.
facts.excerpt: Palatine Chapel, Royal Apartments, Royal Gardens

facts.fact: There is no onsite luggage storage.
facts.excerpt: The site does not have a luggage storage facility.

facts.fact: Not all areas are accessible with reduced mobility; archaeological walls, KingRoger room and PisanTower are listed nonaccessible.
facts.excerpt: Non-Accessible Areas Area Archeologica delle Mura Puniche, Sala Re Ruggero e Torre Pisana.
